Card Q&A.q: Can I use this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect to suspend either my Digimon or Tamer or my opponent's Digimon or Tamer?

Card Q&A.a: 1 of your suspended Digimon with [Vegetation], [Plant] or [Fairy] in any of its traits or 1 of your suspended Digimon with the [CS] trait.
Card Q&A.q: What cards can the attack target be changed to using this card's [Opponent's Turn] effect?

Effect: [On Play] [When Digivolving] By suspending 1 Digimon or Tamer, until your opponent's turn ends, 1 of their Digimon or Tamers can't unsuspend.

[Opponent's Turn] [Once Per Turn] When one of your opponent's Digimon attacks, you may change the attack target to 1 of your suspended Digimon with [Vegetation], [Plant] or [Fairy] in any of its traits or the [CS] trait.
